requirement.original: Improve city cover image matching in generate-html-interactive.py _get_cover_image method
requirement.clarified: Strip parenthetical suffixes from the location argument inside _get_cover_image before performing cache lookups, so that a location like 'Beijing (Wangfujing + Dongdan)' correctly resolves to the 'Beijing' entry in city_covers.
requirement.what: Normalise the location key by stripping everything from the first '(' onward before any cache lookup
requirement.why: Compound location strings constructed from itinerary data do not match bare city names in city_covers, causing cover images to be missing for affected pages

included: Strip parenthetical suffix from location before lookup
Guard against empty string after strip
All three existing lookup tiers (exact, case-insensitive, partial) use the stripped key

success_criteria: _get_cover_image('Beijing (Wangfujing + Dongdan)') returns the URL stored under 'Beijing' in city_covers
_get_cover_image('Shanghai') continues to return the URL stored under 'Shanghai'
constraints: No Unsplash fallback — method must continue to return '' when no cache hit

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Cover image is blank for itinerary pages whose location field contains a parenthetical district suffix such as 'Beijing (Wangfujing + Dongdan)'
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The partial-match branch at line 293-294 checks 'city.lower() in key or key in city.lower()' where key is the full compound location string. Although the first branch ('beijing' in 'beijing (wangfujing + dongdan)') is logically true, the method iterates all cache entries and the first match wins; if no entry happens to be a pure prefix the loop may exit without returning. More importantly, the lookup key is never normalised, so the exact and case-insensitive tiers (lines 280-290) never fire for compound strings. Stripping the suffix before any lookup fixes all three tiers at once.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: ed70308 - Auto-commit 2026-04-06 10:18:17 (introduced wangfujing-dongdan dataset; _get_cover_image unchanged, bug latent since 123f8df)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The _get_cover_image method was written for simple city-name strings; compound location names were not anticipated when the partial-match heuristic was added.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: City cover images are missing for any itinerary page whose location is a compound string, producing a visual gap in the rendered HTML.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Bug latent since initial implementation (commit 123f8df). Surfaced when the wangfujing-dongdan-beijing dataset was added in commit ed70308.

development_approach.strategy: At the top of _get_cover_image, compute a normalised lookup key by splitting on '(' and stripping whitespace. Use this normalised key for all three lookup tiers. Add an early return for empty normalised key.
development_approach.validation_approach: Manual invocation of _get_cover_image with 'Beijing (Wangfujing + Dongdan)' against a city_covers dict containing 'Beijing'; confirm non-empty URL is returned. Also confirm simple name and missing name cases.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause identified from code inspection and git history. No new architecture or external patterns involved.
